answer: Before any agent can start a paid voyage, it must post a refundable bond at a vertex of the job graph. The voyage then proceeds through a trellis of checkpoints, where randomly chosen peers verify each milestone and can slash the bond for fraud. A Sybil farmer would need to fund a separate bond for every fake identity and still lose it at the first failed checkpoint, so spawning thousands of sock puppets costs far more than any single job pays.
